mentions.name: iOS Habit-Tracking App
mentions.description: An iOS habit-tracking app built with Swift and SwiftUI as a learning project, designed to work exactly the way the author wanted after existing habit trackers fell short.
mentions.problem: Habit tracking is saturated, but no existing app worked exactly the way the author wanted.
mentions.source_excerpt: Learning iOS development by building a the habit-tracking app I wished existed - habit tracking has been done to death, but I couldn't find anything that worked exactly the way I wanted, so I figured I'd build it.

evidence.value: Learning iOS development by building a the habit-tracking app I wished existed - habit tracking has been done to death, but I couldn't find anything that worked exactly the way I wanted, so I figured I'd build it.
